title: Heteromorphic tertiary structures of MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 protein variants simultaneously produced in pairs by Ophiocordyceps sinensis strains
authors: Li X; Li Y; Liu W; Qi J; Zhu J
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测冬虫夏草菌MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1蛋白的DNA结合域三级结构，研究其异质性变异，虽聚焦TF-DNA结合域但缺乏互作机制建模与AI/物理模拟方法创新，属广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构预测应用。
abstract: The MATα_HMGbox domain in the MAT1-1-1 protein and the HMG-box_ROX1-like domain in the MAT1-2-1 protein play essential roles in DNA binding and regulating the transcription of genes that control sexual reproduction in Ophiocordyceps sinensis . Previous studies have reported differential occurrences, differential transcription, and alternative splicing of the MAT1-1-1 , MAT1-2-1 , and pheromone receptor genes in Hirsutella sinensis (Genotype #1 among 17 genome-independent genotypes of O. sinensis fungi). In this study, we further demonstrated that the DNA-binding domains of the paired MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 proteins derived from each of the 20 purportedly “pure” O. sinensis strains exhibit heteromorphic tertiary structures, as predicted by AlphaFold 3D structural modeling. These differentially paired mating proteins are characterized by different truncations, diverse 1−4 amino acid substitutions at distinct sites, altered hydrophobicity and secondary structures, and heteromorphic tertiary structures, indicating divergency in the fungal origins of the mating proteins within the mycologically and genetically impure O. sinensis strains. Our findings support the self-sterility hypothesis for O. sinensis and likely ensure the fidelity and genetic diversity of heterothallic or hybrid reproduction during the lifecycle of the Cordyceps sinensis insect–fungal complex.
abstract_zh: MAT1-1-1蛋白中的MATα_HMGbox结构域和MAT1-2-1蛋白中的HMG-box_ROX1样结构域在DNA结合及调控冬虫夏草（Ophiocordyceps sinensis）有性生殖相关基因转录中发挥重要作用。既往研究报道了中华被毛孢（Hirsutella sinensis）（冬虫夏草真菌17种基因组独立基因型中的基因型#1）中MAT1-1-1、MAT1-2-1及信息素受体基因的差异出现、差异转录和选择性剪接。在本研究中，我们进一步证明，来自20株据称“纯”冬虫夏草菌株的配对MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1蛋白的DNA结合结构域，经AlphaFold 3D结构建模预测，表现出异形三级结构。这些差异配对的交配蛋白具有不同的截短、不同位点的1−4个氨基酸替换、改变的疏水性和二级结构，以及异形三级结构，表明在真菌学和遗传学上不纯的冬虫夏草菌株中，交配蛋白的真菌来源存在分歧。我们的研究结果支持冬虫夏草的自不育假说，并可能确保冬虫夏草昆虫-真菌复合体生命周期中异宗配合或杂交繁殖的保真性和遗传多样性。
